prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: repository-only computer-vision test fixture
Primary request: create one entirely fictional adult person who does not resemble any real person, shown from the shoulders up and facing the camera
Scene/backdrop: plain solid light-gray background
Subject: one fictional adult, neutral relaxed expression, eyes open, full face unobstructed, no glasses, no hat, no jewelry
Style/medium: photorealistic synthetic portrait with natural skin texture
Composition/framing: centered symmetrical head-and-shoulders portrait, eye-level, face large enough for a conventional Haar cascade detector, generous margin around the head
Lighting/mood: soft even frontal studio lighting, low shadow, clear facial landmarks
Constraints: synthetic non-existent person only; one face; no text; no logo; no watermark; no border
Avoid: celebrity resemblance, dramatic angle, profile pose, heavy retouching, stylization, painterly rendering, face occlusion, busy background
usage: Static repository test fixture only. The application does not call image generation at runtime.
